items.title: Nippon Columbia malware incident exposes 8.6 million karaoke fan records
items.summary: Daiichi Kosho, a major Japanese entertainment system maker, disclosed that a malware infection at its contractor, Nippon Columbia, exposed more than 8.7 million customer and employee records. [...]

items.title: P7 DarkSword iOS Exploit Kit Adds Crypto Wallet Data Theft and Remote Commands
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a previously unseen variant of the DarkSword iOS exploit kit called P7 DarkSword. "Compared with the variants we usually observe, P7 reduces its on-device footprint, adds on-device keychain and crypto-wallet theft, and adds two way C2 communication with the attacker's infrastructure," iVerify said in a new report published Thursday.
